THE NETWORK: a transformer with 12 layers of width 768, 12 attention heads of size 64, and 125,226,240 weights.

Tensors (rows x columns):

  P: 2048 x 768 (one row per position)
  F.scale, F.shift: 768
  and for each layer i from 0 to 11:
  Li.norm1.scale, Li.norm1.shift: 768
  Li.qkv.W: 768 x 2304, Li.qkv.b: 2304
  Li.out.W: 768 x 768, Li.out.b: 768
  Li.norm2.scale, Li.norm2.shift: 768
  Li.up.W: 768 x 3072, Li.up.b: 3072
  Li.down.W: 3072 x 768, Li.down.b: 768

The computation, for input tokens t_0 ... t_(n-1), with no start token added:
  x_j = E[t_j] + P[j]
  For each layer i in order:
    y_j = LN(x_j; Li.norm1)
    a_j = y_j @ Li.qkv.W + Li.qkv.b. Split a_j into q_j (entries 0-767), k_j (768-1535), v_j (1536-2303).

    x_j = x_j + c_j @ Li.out.W + Li.out.b

LN(u; n) = (u - mean(u)) / sqrt(var(u) + 0.00001) * n.scale + n.shift, element by element, with the mean and population variance taken over the 768 entries of u.
gelu here is the standard smooth approximation of u * Phi(u), which differs from it by at most 0.0005.

import numpy as np
import scipy.linalg as la
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits

with threadpool_limits(limits=4):
    H = {}
    for l in range(12):
        scale = W[f"L{l}.norm1.scale"].astype(np.float64)
        A = W[f"L{l}.qkv.W"].astype(np.float64)
        OA = W[f"L{l}.out.W"].astype(np.float64)
        for h in range(12):
            a, b = 64*h, 64*(h+1)
            mats = []
            for offset in (0, 768, 1536):
                M = scale[:, None] * A[:, offset+a:offset+b]
                M -= M.mean(axis=0, keepdims=True)
                mats.append(M)
            Q, K, V = mats
            O = OA[a:b].copy()
            O -= O.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)
            qkn = np.sqrt(np.sum((Q.T @ Q) * (K.T @ K)))
            ovn = np.sqrt(np.sum((V.T @ V) * (O @ O.T)))
            ev = la.eigvals(O @ V)
            copy = ev.real.sum() / (np.abs(ev).sum() + 1e-12)
            H[l, h] = dict(Q=Q, K=K, V=V, O=O,
                           qkn=qkn, ovn=ovn, copy=copy)

    print("Earlier-head alignment: <QK, OV> / (||QK||F ||OV||F).")
    print("Also show eigenvalue positivity of QK @ OV.T for the best source.")
    print("target copy direct_trace/norm | best earlier sources (alignment) | circuit eigcopy")
    results = []
    for l in range(1, 10):
        sources = [(sl, sh) for sl in range(min(l, 5)) for sh in range(12)]
        VS = np.concatenate([H[s]["V"] for s in sources], axis=1)
        OS = np.concatenate([H[s]["O"] for s in sources], axis=0)
        QA = np.concatenate([H[l, h]["Q"] for h in range(12)], axis=1)
        KA = np.concatenate([H[l, h]["K"] for h in range(12)], axis=1)
        VQ = VS.T @ QA
        OK = OS @ KA
        for h in range(12):
            t = H[l, h]
            if t["copy"] < 0.15:
                continue
            records = []
            for j, s in enumerate(sources):
                u = VQ[64*j:64*j+64, 64*h:64*h+64]
                v = OK[64*j:64*j+64, 64*h:64*h+64]
                tr = np.sum(u*v)
                align = tr / (t["qkn"] * H[s]["ovn"] + 1e-12)
                records.append((align, s, u, v))
            records.sort(key=lambda r: r[0], reverse=True)
            best = records[0]
            ev = la.eigvals(best[3].T @ best[2])
            ec = ev.real.sum() / (np.abs(ev).sum() + 1e-12)
            direct = np.sum(t["Q"] * t["K"]) / t["qkn"]
            desc = " ".join(f"{s[0]}.{s[1]}:{score:.4f}"
                            for score, s, _, _ in records[:4])
            print(f"{l}.{h:<2} {t['copy']:6.3f} {direct:8.3f} | {desc} | {ec:6.3f}")
            results.append((best[0] * max(t["copy"], 0), l, h, best[1], ec))
    print("\nTop combined alignment * OV eigenvalue-copy score:")
    for score, l, h, s, ec in sorted(results, reverse=True)[:20]:
        print(f"{l}.{h}: {score:.5f}, source {s[0]}.{s[1]}, circuit eigcopy {ec:.3f}")
